name: Pixel-aligned Volumetric Avatars (PVA)
definition: A novel framework for the estimation of a volumetric 3D avatar from only a few input images of a human head. It generalizes to unseen identities and expressions at test time by combining neural radiance fields with local, pixel-aligned features extracted directly from the inputs.
summary: Pixel-aligned Volumetric Avatars estimate volumetric 3D avatars from few images using local pixel-aligned features to enable view synthesis without global latent codes or explicit 3D supervision.
